name: RadNet Inc.
summary:
RadNet (RDNT) reported earnings of $0.30 per share on revenue of $638.26 million for the . The consensus earnings estimate was $0.21 per share on revenue of $637.56 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 42.86% while revenue grew 22.07% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects 2026 revenue of $2.385 billion to $2.435 billion. The company's previous guidance was revenue of $2.325 billion to $2.375 billion, and the current consensus revenue estimate is $2.510 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

RadNet Inc is a provider of freestanding, fixed-site outpatient diagnostic imaging services in the United States. Its services include magnetic resonance imaging, computed tomography, positron emission tomography, nuclear medicine, and among others.
subject: RadNet Beat Consensus Estimates, Raises Guidance, but Remains Below Estimates
